definition_zh: 随机过程的特定统计特征对时间或位置平移保持不变的性质。
usage_overview: 在轨道几何退化的随机过程分析中，平稳性用作谱描述的重要前提，涉及所考察的统计特征在时间或位置平移下是否保持不变。

complete_examples.text: Instead, a statistical and mathematical model is proposed to randomly estimate the evolution of track irregularities with a guarantee of the stationarity of track geometries.

The main novelty lies in a proposal of regarding the geometric deterioration of track irregularities equivalently as the evolution of power spectral densities (PSD), and consequently, the stationarity of track irregularities and a robust dynamic assessment can be guaranteed.
